A projective-line quotient of the Rogalski–Sierra algebra; Alec Kriebel; version 1.0; preprint date 2026-10-16; problem 30001478; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/789. For the exact six-relation R(alpha,beta), the nonzero homogeneous completely prime linear ideal I=(x3-x1,x4-x2) is strictly below R+, and the exact quotient is B(P1,O(1),sigma), sigma[s:t]=[s+beta*t:beta*s+t]. The unital graded surjection has positive-dimensional projective target, Hilbert series (1-z)^(-2) and GK-dimension 2. This fully refutes both literal assertions printed in the 2010 OWR report and 2012 Rogalski–Sierra article for all prescribed algebraically independent parameters. The presentation theorem works over every field for beta^2!=1 and arbitrary alpha; in characteristic two it does not identify the journal geometric family, whose fractional parameter conversion is used only in characteristic different from two. No prime classification, embedding, common graded quotient ring or surface-dimensional image is claimed. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof verification.
